Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

assessment.summary: This is a solid, technically faithful Italian rendering with every code block and quantity intact and clean MDX. The dry voice mostly survives. Nothing blocks at severity 4 or higher. The main issue still open is register consistency: tu becomes voi, headings mix infinitive and imperative, and the related post gets two different titles. Smaller polish items: typography consistency, the ambiguous 'limiti dei rifiuti', and a few calques ('è sensazioni', 'appartengono a un dataset', 'ticket fallito').

findings.quote: Nel momento in cui aggiungi un router, introduci un nuovo comportamento di sistema da testare.
findings.sourceQuote: The moment you add a router, you have a new system behavior to test.
findings.claim: The intro addresses the reader as tu, and then from 'Se il router produce soltanto una risposta finale, state tirando a indovinare' onward the text switches to voi. The title 'Non temere' and the first link text are tu, but the Resources entry for the same post is 'Non sposate il vostro modello'. This inconsistency is noticeable to Italian readers and undermines the credible-local-writer goal.
findings.suggestion: Pick one register throughout. Voi is more common in Italian tech blogs; if you choose it, adjust the intro ('smettete', 'Usate', 'Mantenete', 'aggiungete', 'misurate') and make both link texts consistent, e.g. 'Non sposate il vostro modello'. Alternatively, keep tu everywhere.

findings.quote: ## Rendere valutabile la decisione del router
findings.sourceQuote: ## Make the router decision scorable
findings.claim: Headings mix infinitive form ('Rendere…', 'Scrivere…', 'Eseguire prima…') with voi imperatives ('Aggiungete…', 'Promuovete…', 'Eseguite…', 'Misurate…'). The source headings are uniformly imperative.
findings.suggestion: Use voi imperatives consistently: 'Rendete valutabile la decisione del router', 'Scrivete uno scorer…', 'Eseguite prima il piccolo ciclo di eval'.

findings.quote: tool consentiti, limiti dei rifiuti, evidenze
findings.sourceQuote: allowed tools, refusal boundaries, evidence
findings.claim: In Italian, 'rifiuti' reads first as 'waste/garbage', so 'limiti dei rifiuti' is ambiguous. Earlier the text correctly uses 'comportamento di rifiuto'.
findings.suggestion: 'tool consentiti, confini di rifiuto, evidenze' or 'tool consentiti, casi in cui deve rifiutare, evidenze'.

findings.quote: il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.
findings.sourceQuote: your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.
findings.claim: 'è sensazioni' is an awkward singular/plural predicate and loses the punch of 'vibes'.
findings.suggestion: 'il tuo model router è solo andare a sensazione, con una dispatch table attaccata' or 'è puro vibe con una tabella di dispatch'.

findings.quote: È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione.
findings.sourceQuote: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
findings.claim: The singular 'la cicatrice' is a flat rendering of 'scar tissue', which implies accumulated damage. The straight quotes also clash with the «» used elsewhere.
findings.suggestion: 'È in «Altro» che si accumulano le cicatrici della produzione.'

findings.quote: La correttezza della route non richiede un modello giudice.
findings.sourceQuote: Route accuracy does not need a judge model.
findings.claim: The same metric appears as 'correttezza della route', 'accuratezza della route' and 'accuratezza delle route'. An inconsistent term for a named metric (the route-accuracy scorer) is confusing.
findings.suggestion: Standardise on 'accuratezza della route' everywhere.

findings.quote: Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
findings.sourceQuote: Evals reward boring seams.
findings.claim: The loanword wanders between 'le eval', 'gli eval' and 'le evals', and 'scorers' also appears alongside 'scorer'. In Italian, borrowed nouns are normally invariable, with one fixed gender.
findings.suggestion: Use 'le eval' and 'gli scorer' (invariable) consistently, including 'Una valutazione richiede esempi e scorer'.

findings.quote: Quelli appartengono a un dataset.
findings.sourceQuote: Those belong in a dataset.
findings.claim: This is a calque of 'belong in'. Idiomatic Italian would be 'vanno in un dataset' or 'il loro posto è in un dataset'.
findings.suggestion: 'Il loro posto è in un dataset.'

findings.quote: il ticket fallito di un cliente
findings.sourceQuote: the failed customer ticket
findings.claim: 'ticket fallito' is unnatural; the intended meaning is the ticket the system got wrong.
findings.suggestion: 'il ticket del cliente andato storto' or 'il ticket su cui il sistema ha fallito'.

findings.quote: È nelle medie che i fallimenti utili vanno a morire.
findings.sourceQuote: Averages are where useful failures go to retire.
findings.claim: The source bends the stock 'go to die' into 'go to retire', and the candidate reverts to the stock idiom. The meaning survives but the twist is lost. This is an acceptable alternative.
findings.suggestion: Optionally: 'È nelle medie che i fallimenti utili vanno in pensione.'

findings.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
findings.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
findings.claim: 'Four figures' is recreated as 'migliaia di euro'. This is a reasonable localization with no new factual claim, since the source doesn't name a currency. Acceptable.

sourceConcerns: The source's `validRouterJsonScorer` returns the reason 'Router output was not valid JSON.' even when the JSON parses but the route, confidence or reason field is invalid. This is inherited source behavior, not a translation defect.
The live-scorer example re-declares `routerDecisionAgent` with the same id as the earlier file. It is illustrative in the source; readers may copy it as a duplicate export.

The resource title 'Fight Evils with Evals!' relies on a pun that cannot fully survive translation. 'Combattete i mali con le evals!' is a reasonable fallback, but the target post's actual Italian title should be checked for consistency.

assessment.summary: Not ready: repair the JSON visibility prohibition and unsupported monetary localization. The article is complete and readable at 4/5, with intact technical structure, but several medium issues still weaken natural Italian and semantic precision.

findings.quote: Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON.
findings.sourceQuote: Users never need to see this JSON.
findings.claim: The source says displaying the JSON is unnecessary; the translation says users must never see it. This introduces a product requirement.
findings.suggestion: Use «Non serve mostrare questo JSON agli utenti.» This preserves optional internal visibility without introducing a prohibition.

findings.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
findings.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
findings.claim: The source specifies four-digit savings without naming a currency. Adding euros invents a factual unit; «migliaia» also weakens the explicit four-digit magnitude. This violates the factual-quantity constraint.
findings.suggestion: Use «un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare una cifra a quattro zeri» only if the source changes; for the current source, use «un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare una somma a quattro cifre al mese». Preserve the magnitude and leave the currency unspecified.

findings.quote: Usa un modello economico per il lavoro economico.
findings.sourceQuote: Use a cheap model for cheap work.
findings.claim: «Lavoro economico» sounds like inexpensive labor, whereas the next sentence establishes task difficulty as the routing criterion. The literal repetition obscures the practical advice.
findings.suggestion: Use «Usa un modello economico per i compiti semplici.» The adaptation loses the repeated adjective but gains immediate clarity while preserving the contrast with difficult work.

findings.quote: Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.
findings.sourceQuote: If you do not measure that, your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.
findings.claim: «È sensazioni» is an awkward nominal construction and does not land as an intentional Italian joke. This matters because the sentence delivers the introduction's central provocation.
findings.suggestion: Use «Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è un “vado a naso” con una tabella di dispatch.» This recreates unsupported intuition as a recognizable Italian expression; it loses the slang flavor of «vibes» but restores the dry punchline.

findings.quote: Mastra offre le superfici necessarie
findings.sourceQuote: Mastra has the surfaces
findings.claim: Bare «superfici» is an opaque calque here. The following list describes facilities developers can use, and the Italian phrasing needlessly delays that meaning.
findings.suggestion: Use «Mastra mette a disposizione gli strumenti necessari». This replaces the spatial abstraction with the practical function of the listed features; no factual content is lost.

findings.quote: È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione.
findings.sourceQuote: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
findings.claim: The singular «cicatrice della produzione» sounds like a defect belonging to production, rather than accumulated experience from production failures.
findings.suggestion: Use «In “Altro” finiscono le cicatrici che ti lascia la produzione.» This retains the injury metaphor and restores accumulated hard-earned experience, while dropping the literal tissue image.

findings.quote:
Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.

Se il router produce soltanto una risposta finale, state tirando a indovinare sulla decisione.
findings.sourceQuote:
If you do not measure that, your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.

If the router only produces a final answer, you are guessing about the decision.
findings.claim: These separated passages switch from «tu» to «voi» without a change in audience or purpose. The same article title also appears as both «Non sposare il tuo modello» and «Non sposate il vostro modello».
findings.suggestion: Choose one reader address throughout; singular fits the existing title and opening. Standardize the repeated linked title as well. English leaves number unspecified, so either consistent choice is defensible.

findings.quote: Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
findings.sourceQuote: Evals reward boring seams.
findings.claim: The literal «punti di giunzione noiosi» makes the architectural idea harder to recover. The preceding example is about exposing a simple, testable boundary.
findings.suggestion: Use «Le eval funzionano meglio con interfacce semplici, senza sorprese.» This gives up the seam metaphor and literal boredom but preserves the praise for predictable, testable interfaces.

findings.quote: La correttezza della route non richiede un modello giudice. Deve fare il parse del JSON e confrontare un campo.
findings.sourceQuote: Route accuracy does not need a judge model. It needs to parse JSON and compare one field.
findings.claim: The second sentence makes «correttezza» the apparent actor performing parsing. The intended operation is clear from the code, but the prose stumbles.
findings.suggestion: Use «Per verificare la correttezza della route non serve un modello giudice. Basta fare il parsing del JSON e confrontare un campo.»

findings.quote: correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità
findings.sourceQuote: correctness, faithfulness, usefulness
findings.claim: «Aderenza ai fatti» suggests factual correctness, whereas faithfulness concerns fidelity to the supplied information. The translation partly collapses two separately listed evaluation criteria; the earlier table already uses «fedeltà».
findings.suggestion: Use «correttezza, fedeltà alle informazioni fornite, utilità», or retain the earlier «fedeltà» consistently.

findings.quote: Il primo prompt di routing è solitamente un paragrafo pieno di decisioni opinabili.
findings.sourceQuote: The first routing prompt is usually a paragraph of judgment calls.
findings.claim: «Decisioni opinabili» implies dubious or contestable decisions. «Judgment calls» describes decisions requiring judgment without necessarily criticizing their quality.
findings.suggestion: Use «Il primo prompt di routing è di solito un paragrafo di scelte affidate al giudizio del modello.» This preserves the contrast with later deterministic rules without adding disapproval.

findings.quote: Una valutazione richiede esempi e scorers:
findings.sourceQuote: An eval needs examples and scorers:
findings.claim: «Scorers» alternates with invariant «scorer»; the article also alternates «le eval», «gli eval» and «le evals». This is minor editorial inconsistency, not a technical failure.
findings.suggestion: Standardize prose to «gli scorer» and one consistent form for eval, such as «le eval». Preserve code and controlled identifiers.

sourceConcerns: The inherited parser returns `JSON.parse(textFromAgentOutput(output))` without validating the result as an object. Valid JSON `null` therefore reaches `decision.route` and causes a property-access error rather than a zero score. This issue is present in both texts.

The inherited validity check uses `decision.reason` as a truthiness test, so it accepts truthy non-string values despite the declared `reason: string` contract. Its failure message, "Router output was not valid JSON.", also conflates syntactic JSON errors with invalid decision fields. These are source-code concerns, not translation defects.

findings.claim: La cicatrice della produzione sounds like a literal translated image. The source evokes accumulated lessons from production failures, giving the miscellaneous constraints hard-earned importance.
findings.suggestion: Use «Quell’ultima riga conta. È sotto “Altro” che finiscono le cicatrici lasciate dalla produzione.» This retains the injury metaphor and production experience, loses the literal lives construction and gains natural Italian phrasing.

findings.quote: Sì, è un po’ artificiale. Bene. Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
findings.sourceQuote: Yes, this is a little artificial. Good. Evals reward boring seams.
findings.claim: Punti di giunzione sounds mechanical and does not readily convey the simple software interfaces that permit isolated tests. The surrounding explicit decision contract supplies that technical meaning.
findings.suggestion: Use «Sì, è un po’ artificiale. Bene. Alle eval piacciono le interfacce noiose.» This trades the seam metaphor for its software meaning, gaining immediate comprehension while preserving the dry praise of boring boundaries.

findings.quote: È qui che un giudice LLM può essere utile, ma solo con una rubrica ben definita.
findings.sourceQuote: This is where an LLM judge helps, but only with a tight rubric.
findings.claim: Rubrica normally suggests a directory, column or recurring feature in Italian. It does not clearly convey the scoring criteria demonstrated immediately below.
findings.suggestion: Use «È qui che un giudice LLM può essere utile, ma solo con una griglia di valutazione ben definita.»

findings.quote: | Output dello specialista | correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità |
findings.sourceQuote: | Specialist output | correctness, faithfulness, usefulness |
findings.claim: Aderenza ai fatti describes factual correctness, whereas faithfulness evaluates fidelity to the relevant source or reference material. Because correctness is already a separate item, this translation collapses a technical distinction and conflicts with fedeltà used earlier.
findings.suggestion: Use «correttezza, fedeltà, utilità», consistently with the earlier quality-axis table.

findings.quote: Se il router produce soltanto una risposta finale, state tirando a indovinare sulla decisione. Potete valutare l’output, ma non potete capire se la route era quella giusta.
findings.sourceQuote: If the router only produces a final answer, you are guessing about the decision. You can score the output, but you cannot tell whether the route was right.
findings.claim: The introduction addresses one reader with «Usa», «Mantieni» and «aggiungi», then this section switches to voi for the remainder. Either register is valid, but the unexplained change makes the voice inconsistent. The linked title likewise changes from «Non sposare il tuo modello» to «Non sposate il vostro modello».
findings.suggestion: Keep the established singular address: «stai», «Puoi», «non puoi», and apply it consistently to subsequent instructions and repeated article titles. This preserves the direct relationship established by the opening; no factual or structural change is needed.

findings.quote: Il primo prompt di routing è solitamente un paragrafo pieno di decisioni opinabili.
findings.sourceQuote: The first routing prompt is usually a paragraph of judgment calls.
findings.claim: Decisioni opinabili suggests debatable or questionable decisions. Judgment calls describes choices requiring judgment, which the source accepts as reasonable for a prototype before making them more deterministic.
findings.suggestion: Use «Il primo prompt di routing è solitamente un paragrafo di scelte affidate al giudizio del modello.» This makes the contextual meaning explicit and removes the unintended implication that the choices are dubious.

findings.quote: | Sicurezza e ambito | tool consentiti, limiti dei rifiuti, evidenze |
findings.sourceQuote: | Safety and scope | allowed tools, refusal boundaries, evidence |
findings.claim: Limiti dei rifiuti does not clearly identify the policy boundaries governing refusal. This table should tell developers which behavior to evaluate.
findings.suggestion: Use «tool consentiti, quando rifiutare una richiesta, evidenze». The adaptation replaces an opaque noun phrase with the behavior the source asks developers to check.

sourceConcerns: Inherited scorer validation is weaker than its declared contract: «return JSON.parse(textFromAgentOutput(output)) as {» provides no runtime object guard, so parsed JSON null can make «decision.route» throw. Also, «return validRoute && validConfidence && decision.reason ? 1 : 0;» accepts truthy non-string reasons despite «reason: string». These are source-code concerns, not translation defects or permission to alter the preserved code.

The inherited failure explanation «Router output was not valid JSON.» also covers syntactically valid JSON with an invalid route, confidence or missing reason. It therefore conflates JSON syntax with decision-schema validity, which can mislead debugging.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

issues.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
issues.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
issues.claim: The candidate introduces euros although the source specifies no currency. It also replaces an explicit four-digit amount with a less bounded expression. This violates the factual-quantity constraint.
issues.suggestion: Use «un noioso `if` che ti fa risparmiare una cifra a quattro cifre al mese», or the more compact «un noioso `if` che ti fa risparmiare quattro cifre al mese». Do not supply a currency.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON.
issues.sourceQuote: Users never need to see this JSON.
issues.claim: Non devono mai vedere reads as a prohibition. The source says displaying the JSON is unnecessary, leaving that design choice open. This changes the guidance about visibility.
issues.suggestion: Use «Non serve che gli utenti vedano questo JSON.»
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Usa un modello economico per il lavoro economico.
issues.sourceQuote: Use a cheap model for cheap work.
issues.claim: Lavoro economico is an unnatural description of tasks and can suggest inexpensive labor. The following contrast with difficult work establishes that the intended distinction is task difficulty and resource needs.
issues.suggestion: Use «Usa un modello economico per i compiti semplici.» This loses the exact repetition of cheap but gains a natural opening and makes the source's contrast with difficult work clear.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.
issues.sourceQuote: If you do not measure that, your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.
issues.claim: È sensazioni carries the dictionary meaning of vibes but does not recreate the dismissive joke naturally. This matters because the line states the introduction's central provocation.
issues.suggestion: Use «Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router va a sentimento, con una tabella di dispatch.» The adaptation retains intuition dressed up as machinery; it loses the nominal English construction and gains an idiomatic Italian punchline.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Mastra offre le superfici necessarie per trasformare quell’ipotesi in qualcosa di testabile
issues.sourceQuote: Mastra has the surfaces to turn that hypothesis into something testable
issues.claim: Superfici is a noticeable calque here. The subsequent list names practical evaluation tools, so the abstract wording adds friction without useful precision.
issues.suggestion: Use «Mastra offre gli strumenti necessari per trasformare quell’ipotesi in qualcosa di testabile». This replaces the API-surface metaphor with the concrete function of the listed facilities, gaining clarity while losing a little interface-oriented nuance.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Quell’ultima riga conta. È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione.
issues.sourceQuote: That last row matters. "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
issues.claim: La cicatrice della produzione sounds like a literal translated image. The source evokes accumulated lessons from production failures, giving the miscellaneous constraints hard-earned importance.
issues.suggestion: Use «Quell’ultima riga conta. È sotto “Altro” che finiscono le cicatrici lasciate dalla produzione.» This retains the injury metaphor and production experience, loses the literal lives construction and gains natural Italian phrasing.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Sì, è un po’ artificiale. Bene. Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.

issues.suggestion: Use «Sì, è un po’ artificiale. Bene. Alle eval piacciono le interfacce noiose.» This trades the seam metaphor for its software meaning, gaining immediate comprehension while preserving the dry praise of boring boundaries.

issues.quote: È qui che un giudice LLM può essere utile, ma solo con una rubrica ben definita.

issues.suggestion: Use «È qui che un giudice LLM può essere utile, ma solo con una griglia di valutazione ben definita.»
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione.
issues.sourceQuote: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
issues.claim: The singular 'la cicatrice' is a flat rendering of 'scar tissue', which implies accumulated damage. The straight quotes also clash with the «» used elsewhere.
issues.suggestion: 'È in «Altro» che si accumulano le cicatrici della produzione.'
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: La correttezza della route non richiede un modello giudice.
issues.sourceQuote: Route accuracy does not need a judge model.
issues.claim: The same metric appears as 'correttezza della route', 'accuratezza della route' and 'accuratezza delle route'. An inconsistent term for a named metric (the route-accuracy scorer) is confusing.
issues.suggestion: Standardise on 'accuratezza della route' everywhere.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
issues.sourceQuote: Evals reward boring seams.
issues.claim: The loanword wanders between 'le eval', 'gli eval' and 'le evals', and 'scorers' also appears alongside 'scorer'. In Italian, borrowed nouns are normally invariable, with one fixed gender.
issues.suggestion: Use 'le eval' and 'gli scorer' (invariable) consistently, including 'Una valutazione richiede esempi e scorer'.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Quelli appartengono a un dataset.
issues.sourceQuote: Those belong in a dataset.
issues.claim: This is a calque of 'belong in'. Idiomatic Italian would be 'vanno in un dataset' or 'il loro posto è in un dataset'.
issues.suggestion: 'Il loro posto è in un dataset.'
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

votes.reason: Il target scrive «un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese», mentre la fonte dice «saves you four figures a month». La fonte non indica alcuna valuta, quindi «euro» è un fatto aggiunto. «Migliaia» inoltre allarga un importo a quattro cifre (1.000–9.999). Il vincolo sulle quantità fattuali lo vieta e nessun voto può derogarlo. Il fix giusto è «quattro cifre al mese», senza valuta. Il suggerimento «una cifra a quattro cifre» è invece sgrammaticato e va scartato.

La fonte dice «Users never need to see this JSON», cioè non serve mostrarlo. Il target scrive «Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON», che è un divieto. Il periodo successivo dice che il JSON può essere un passaggio interno, un handoff o uno span di trace, quindi la scelta resta aperta. Il testo italiano cambia la prescrizione tecnica. Va corretto con «Non serve che gli utenti vedano questo JSON».

«Usa un modello economico per il lavoro economico» è riconoscibile come ripetizione voluta del «cheap … cheap». Ma «lavoro economico» in italiano suona strano e può far pensare a manodopera a basso costo. Il contrasto con «lavoro davvero difficile» chiarisce l'intento. È un ritocco di stile, non un errore di significato, quindi non tocca il 3 proposto. «Compiti semplici» o «lavori poco impegnativi» sono più naturali.

«il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch» è una calca nominale letterale di «vibes with a dispatch table». Il predicato «è sensazioni» non suona come una battuta italiana e la frase è la provocazione centrale dell'introduzione. «Va a sentimento, con una tabella di dispatch» o «è puro vibe con una tabella di dispatch» conservano la stoccata. Questa voce è rafforzata dal fatto che anche 2e6c… segnala lo stesso punto.

«le superfici necessarie» è una calca di «surfaces». In italiano «superficie» non si usa così per indicare strumenti o API, se non nell'espressione «superficie d'attacco». L'elenco che segue nomina strumenti concreti, quindi «strumenti» è più chiaro. È un difetto minore di resa, non bloccante.

«È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione» traduce alla lettera «scar tissue … lives». Il singolare e «vive» perdono l'idea di danni accumulati. Il testo italiano risulta piatto proprio dove la fonte ha un'immagine secca e ironica. «Si accumulano le cicatrici lasciate dalla produzione» conserva il senso. Le virgolette dritte "Altro" stonano anche con le «» usate altrove.

«Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi» rende «seams» alla lettera. In ingegneria del software «seam» è un concetto preciso, quindi la metafora ha un senso. Ma «punti di giunzione» suona meccanico. Il suggerimento «interfacce» sposta però il significato: un seam non coincide con un'interfaccia. Serve un ritocco, ma non quello proposto e non al grado 3. Sarebbe meglio «giunture» o tenere «seam» come prestito.

In «una rubrica ben definita», «rubrica» in italiano è soprattutto una rubrica telefonica o una rubrica giornalistica. Un lettore sviluppatore non la associa ai criteri di punteggio (1.0/0.5/0.0) mostrati subito sotto. «Griglia di valutazione» è il termine corrente e non perde nulla.

La tabella in questione ha «correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità» per «correctness, faithfulness, usefulness». Ma nella tabella dei quattro assi lo stesso termine è reso «fedeltà». «Faithfulness» indica aderenza alla fonte o al contesto, non ai «fatti» in generale. Con «correttezza» già presente, la resa sovrappone due criteri distinti e rompe la coerenza terminologica. Va allineato a «fedeltà».

Il testo inizia in tu («Usa», «Mantieni», «aggiungi», «il tuo model router») e da «state tirando a indovinare» passa al voi («Potete», «date», «Partite», «vi serve»). Poi il titolo linkato passa da «Non sposare il tuo modello» a «Non sposate il vostro modello». Entrambi i registri sono legittimi, ma il cambio non è motivato e la voce diretta dell'autore ne esce incrinata. Il titolo «Non temere» impone il tu. Va scelto un solo registro per tutto il testo.

«Judgment calls» sono per natura scelte discrezionali e discutibili. «Un paragrafo pieno di decisioni opinabili» rende bene questa idea. Nel contesto la frase dice «Va bene per un prototipo», quindi il lettore non la legge come un giudizio di scarsa qualità. La riformulazione proposta è più lunga e introduce «del modello», che la fonte non dice. È una variante valida, non un difetto.

«limiti dei rifiuti» in italiano si legge prima come «limiti dei rifiuti (waste)». Il testo usa correttamente «comportamento di rifiuto» nella tabella dei quattro assi, quindi la resa è incoerente. Questa tabella dice agli sviluppatori cosa valutare e il termine deve essere inequivocabile. «Quando rifiutare una richiesta» o «confini di rifiuto» sono soluzioni valide.

Il passaggio da tu a voi è reale. L'introduzione usa «Usa», «Mantieni», «aggiungi», poi da «state tirando a indovinare» in poi il testo è al voi. I due link allo stesso articolo sono anche diversi: «Non sposare il tuo modello» e, nelle Risorse, «Non sposate il vostro modello». È un problema di coerenza che un lettore italiano nota subito. La scelta del registro resta libera, ma va unificata.

I titoli alternano l'infinito («Rendere valutabile…», «Scrivere uno scorer…», «Eseguire prima…») e l'imperativo voi («Aggiungete…», «Promuovete…», «Eseguite…», «Misurate…»). Nella fonte sono tutti imperativi («Make», «Write», «Run», «Add», «Promote»). L'incoerenza è minore ma visibile nell'indice. Va scelta una forma unica, coerente con il registro del corpo del testo.

«limiti dei rifiuti» è ambiguo con «rifiuti» come scarti. Il contesto (sicurezza e ambito) limita il danno, quindi è un problema minore. Nella tabella precedente il testo usa già «comportamento di rifiuto», che è la forma giusta. «Confini di rifiuto» o «casi in cui deve rifiutare» risolvono il problema.

«è sensazioni» è un predicato plurale su soggetto singolare, e non rende il gergo «vibes». L'osservazione è corretta ma coincide con 0f91…, che copre lo stesso punto in modo più completo e con severità 3. Qui resta un difetto minore di resa, da risolvere con la stessa riscrittura.

Il singolare «la cicatrice» appiattisce «scar tissue», che indica danni accumulati nel tempo. Le virgolette dritte "Altro" sono anche incoerenti con le «» usate nel resto del testo (per esempio «qual è il modello migliore?»). Difetto minore, da sistemare insieme a e1b1…: «In «Altro» si accumulano le cicatrici della produzione».

Il target usa per la stessa metrica «La correttezza della route», «accuratezza della route» (tabella) e «accuratezza delle route» (titolo e testo: «nell'accuratezza delle route»). Corrisponde allo scorer `route-accuracy`. Più nomi per una metrica con nome proprio confondono il lettore tecnico. Va unificato, preferibilmente «accuratezza della route».

Il prestito oscilla: «Le eval premiano», «gli eval smettono di sembrare», «le evals diventano utili», «Combattete i mali con le evals!». Anche «esempi e scorers» compare accanto a «scorer» e «gli scorer di Mastra». I prestiti italiani restano di norma invariati e con genere fisso. L'incoerenza è minore ma visibile. Vanno scelti «le eval» e «gli scorer» ovunque, tranne dove un titolo rimanda a un testo già pubblicato.

«Quelli appartengono a un dataset» segue da vicino «Those belong in a dataset». «Appartengono a» è comprensibile ma suona meno naturale di «vanno in un dataset» o «il loro posto è in un dataset». È un ritocco di stile, non un errore di significato.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

issues.quote: il ticket fallito di un cliente
issues.sourceQuote: the failed customer ticket
issues.claim: 'ticket fallito' is unnatural; the intended meaning is the ticket the system got wrong.
issues.suggestion: 'il ticket del cliente andato storto' or 'il ticket su cui il sistema ha fallito'.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: È nelle medie che i fallimenti utili vanno a morire.
issues.sourceQuote: Averages are where useful failures go to retire.
issues.claim: The source bends the stock 'go to die' into 'go to retire', and the candidate reverts to the stock idiom. The meaning survives but the twist is lost. This is an acceptable alternative.
issues.suggestion: Optionally: 'È nelle medie che i fallimenti utili vanno in pensione.'
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
issues.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
issues.claim: 'Four figures' is recreated as 'migliaia di euro'. This is a reasonable localization with no new factual claim, since the source doesn't name a currency. Acceptable.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON.
issues.sourceQuote: Users never need to see this JSON.
issues.claim: The source says displaying the JSON is unnecessary; the translation says users must never see it. This introduces a product requirement.
issues.suggestion: Use «Non serve mostrare questo JSON agli utenti.» This preserves optional internal visibility without introducing a prohibition.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
issues.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
issues.claim: The source specifies four-digit savings without naming a currency. Adding euros invents a factual unit; «migliaia» also weakens the explicit four-digit magnitude. This violates the factual-quantity constraint.
issues.suggestion: Use «un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare una cifra a quattro zeri» only if the source changes; for the current source, use «un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare una somma a quattro cifre al mese». Preserve the magnitude and leave the currency unspecified.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Usa un modello economico per il lavoro economico.
issues.sourceQuote: Use a cheap model for cheap work.
issues.claim: «Lavoro economico» sounds like inexpensive labor, whereas the next sentence establishes task difficulty as the routing criterion. The literal repetition obscures the practical advice.
issues.suggestion: Use «Usa un modello economico per i compiti semplici.» The adaptation loses the repeated adjective but gains immediate clarity while preserving the contrast with difficult work.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.
issues.sourceQuote: If you do not measure that, your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.
issues.claim: «È sensazioni» is an awkward nominal construction and does not land as an intentional Italian joke. This matters because the sentence delivers the introduction's central provocation.
issues.suggestion: Use «Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è un “vado a naso” con una tabella di dispatch.» This recreates unsupported intuition as a recognizable Italian expression; it loses the slang flavor of «vibes» but restores the dry punchline.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Mastra offre le superfici necessarie
issues.sourceQuote: Mastra has the surfaces
issues.claim: Bare «superfici» is an opaque calque here. The following list describes facilities developers can use, and the Italian phrasing needlessly delays that meaning.
issues.suggestion: Use «Mastra mette a disposizione gli strumenti necessari». This replaces the spatial abstraction with the practical function of the listed features; no factual content is lost.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione.
issues.sourceQuote: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives.
issues.claim: The singular «cicatrice della produzione» sounds like a defect belonging to production, rather than accumulated experience from production failures.
issues.suggestion: Use «In “Altro” finiscono le cicatrici che ti lascia la produzione.» This retains the injury metaphor and restores accumulated hard-earned experience, while dropping the literal tissue image.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote:
Se non lo misuri, il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch.

Se il router produce soltanto una risposta finale, state tirando a indovinare sulla decisione.
issues.sourceQuote:
If you do not measure that, your model router is vibes with a dispatch table.

If the router only produces a final answer, you are guessing about the decision.
issues.claim: These separated passages switch from «tu» to «voi» without a change in audience or purpose. The same article title also appears as both «Non sposare il tuo modello» and «Non sposate il vostro modello».
issues.suggestion: Choose one reader address throughout; singular fits the existing title and opening. Standardize the repeated linked title as well. English leaves number unspecified, so either consistent choice is defensible.
evidenceWarnings: Target quote is not an exact candidate substring
Source quote is not an exact source substring; it may refer to metadata or be unsupported
Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
issues.sourceQuote: Evals reward boring seams.
issues.claim: The literal «punti di giunzione noiosi» makes the architectural idea harder to recover. The preceding example is about exposing a simple, testable boundary.
issues.suggestion: Use «Le eval funzionano meglio con interfacce semplici, senza sorprese.» This gives up the seam metaphor and literal boredom but preserves the praise for predictable, testable interfaces.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: La correttezza della route non richiede un modello giudice. Deve fare il parse del JSON e confrontare un campo.
issues.sourceQuote: Route accuracy does not need a judge model. It needs to parse JSON and compare one field.
issues.claim: The second sentence makes «correttezza» the apparent actor performing parsing. The intended operation is clear from the code, but the prose stumbles.
issues.suggestion: Use «Per verificare la correttezza della route non serve un modello giudice. Basta fare il parsing del JSON e confrontare un campo.»
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità
issues.sourceQuote: correctness, faithfulness, usefulness
issues.claim: «Aderenza ai fatti» suggests factual correctness, whereas faithfulness concerns fidelity to the supplied information. The translation partly collapses two separately listed evaluation criteria; the earlier table already uses «fedeltà».
issues.suggestion: Use «correttezza, fedeltà alle informazioni fornite, utilità», or retain the earlier «fedeltà» consistently.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Il primo prompt di routing è solitamente un paragrafo pieno di decisioni opinabili.
issues.sourceQuote: The first routing prompt is usually a paragraph of judgment calls.
issues.claim: «Decisioni opinabili» implies dubious or contestable decisions. «Judgment calls» describes decisions requiring judgment without necessarily criticizing their quality.
issues.suggestion: Use «Il primo prompt di routing è di solito un paragrafo di scelte affidate al giudizio del modello.» This preserves the contrast with later deterministic rules without adding disapproval.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Una valutazione richiede esempi e scorers:
issues.sourceQuote: An eval needs examples and scorers:
issues.claim: «Scorers» alternates with invariant «scorer»; the article also alternates «le eval», «gli eval» and «le evals». This is minor editorial inconsistency, not a technical failure.
issues.suggestion: Standardize prose to «gli scorer» and one consistent form for eval, such as «le eval». Preserve code and controlled identifiers.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Se il router produce soltanto una risposta finale, state tirando a indovinare sulla decisione.
issues.sourceQuote: If the router only produces a final answer, you are guessing about the decision.
issues.claim: The text starts in second-person singular ('il tuo', 'Usa', 'Mantieni') and switches to plural voi ('state', 'Potete', 'Partite'). Register is inconsistent within one article, and the source 'you' is singular throughout.
issues.suggestion: Pick one form. Either tu throughout ('stai tirando a indovinare', 'Puoi valutare') or voi throughout, including the intro.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: un noioso `if` che vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese
issues.sourceQuote: a boring `if` statement that saves you four figures a month
issues.claim: The source states a quantity ('four figures') with no currency. The translation adds 'euro' and loosens the range to 'migliaia'.
issues.suggestion: Use 'un noioso `if` che ti fa risparmiare quattro cifre al mese', or 'qualche migliaio di dollari/euro' only if currency neutrality is deliberately dropped.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi.
issues.sourceQuote: Evals reward boring seams.
issues.claim: 'eval' is treated inconsistently: 'le eval', 'gli eval smettono', 'le evals diventano utili', and also 'una valutazione'.
issues.suggestion: Standardise on 'le eval' (invariable) or 'le evals', with the feminine article everywhere. Fix 'gli eval smettono di sembrare' and keep 'valutazione' only where a generic evaluation is meant.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: La correttezza della route non richiede un modello giudice.
issues.sourceQuote: Route accuracy does not need a judge model.
issues.claim: 'Route accuracy' becomes 'correttezza della route' here but 'accuratezza delle route' elsewhere. 'Correttezza' is also used for specialist 'correctness', so two concepts collide.
issues.suggestion: Use 'accuratezza della route' consistently and reserve 'correttezza' for correctness.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

issues.quote: il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch
issues.sourceQuote: your model router is vibes with a dispatch table
issues.claim: 'Vibes' is rendered as 'sensazioni', which is weak and reads like a calque. The dry tech-slang edge is lost.
issues.suggestion: Recreate it locally, e.g. 'è andare a sentimento con una tabella di dispatch' or keep 'vibe' as dev jargon.
evidenceWarnings: Missing or unknown evidence references; peers must independently establish or reject this claim

votes.reason: The target says «vi fa risparmiare migliaia di euro al mese», but the source only says "saves you four figures a month" and names no currency. «migliaia» keeps the order of magnitude, so the number itself is not badly distorted. Adding «euro» does add a factual detail the source never states, and the policy forbids that. I rate this 3 rather than blocking because the fix is trivial. «quattro cifre al mese» is idiomatic Italian (as in «uno stipendio a quattro cifre») and keeps the dry tone.

«Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON» most naturally reads in Italian as a ban ("must never see"). The source, "Users never need to see this JSON", only says showing it is unnecessary. The target's own checklist says «anche se gli utenti non la vedranno mai», which is optional, so the two passages now conflict slightly. I rate this 3, not 4: the design guidance shifts only mildly. «Non serve che gli utenti vedano questo JSON» fixes it.

«per il lavoro economico» echoes "cheap work", but in Italian «lavoro economico» points toward cheap labour or the economics of work, not toward simple tasks. The next sentence, «quando il lavoro è davvero difficile», makes the intended contrast clear, so this is polish, not a meaning error. «per i compiti banali» or «per il lavoro da poco» keeps the parallelism and reads naturally.

«il tuo model router è sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch» is grammatically off: a singular subject is equated with the bare plural «sensazioni». The line also loses the jab of "vibes with a dispatch table". This is the key provocation of the introduction, so it counts as noticeable, not optional. The proposed «va a sentimento, con una tabella di dispatch» ("runs on gut feeling") recreates the idiom without adding facts.

«Mastra offre le superfici necessarie» carries over the API-surface metaphor from "has the surfaces". Italian developers will understand it, but it reads as a calque. «gli strumenti necessari» or «i punti d'aggancio» would read more naturally. This is minor polish and does not block.

«È in "Altro" che vive la cicatrice della produzione» translates the image literally and in the singular. "Scar tissue" means damage built up over time, so the plural reading of the suggestion («le cicatrici lasciate dalla produzione» / «si accumulano le cicatrici») is closer. The meaning survives, so this is polish. It overlaps with d36eab200d8656da52f8.

«Le eval premiano i punti di giunzione noiosi» renders "seams" literally. In Italian it sounds like carpentry. The surrounding text about a structured contract makes the meaning recoverable, so this is minor. «interfacce noiose» or «confini noiosi tra i componenti» would read more naturally for developers. It loses the seam image slightly, but that is acceptable.

«solo con una rubrica ben definita» is valid Italian in this context. «rubrica di valutazione» is an established Italian evaluation term, and "rubric" is standard vocabulary for LLM-as-judge setups. The code block right below shows the 1.0/0.5/0.0 criteria, so the phone-book reading is ruled out. «griglia di valutazione» is a valid alternative, not a fix for a defect.

The source lists "correctness, faithfulness, usefulness". The target gives «correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità», which merges faithfulness (fidelity to the source or context) into correctness, a separate item in the same cell. The earlier table already uses «fedeltà» for the same term, so this is also an inconsistency in eval terminology. Replacing it with «fedeltà» fixes both problems.

The target opens in the tu form («Usa», «Mantieni», «aggiungi», «Se non lo misuri») and then switches to voi from «state tirando a indovinare» onward. The same article is also titled two ways: «Non sposare il tuo modello» in the intro and «Non sposate il vostro modello» in Resources. Italian readers notice that kind of register break. Either register works as long as it is applied throughout. This overlaps with 0b134e69e74b9fe3838f.

«un paragrafo pieno di decisioni opinabili» leans toward "questionable decisions". "A paragraph of judgment calls" is neutral, and the source immediately accepts it with "Fine for a prototype." The drift is small, because judgment calls are subjective by nature. The proposed «affidate al giudizio del modello» over-specifies whose judgment. «scelte discrezionali» or «valutazioni a occhio» would be better.

«limiti dei rifiuti» can be read in Italian as "waste limits", and it does not clearly express "refusal boundaries". The first table already uses the unambiguous «comportamento di rifiuto». This table cell tells developers what to test, so the ambiguity matters. «quando rifiutare», «confini di rifiuto» or «casi in cui deve rifiutare» resolve it. This overlaps with c0ebb6a092f71754ae21.

This is confirmed. The intro uses tu («Nel momento in cui aggiungi», «Se non lo misuri»), and later sections use voi («Potete valutare», «Tenete separati gli assi»). The same linked title appears as «Non sposare il tuo modello» and as «Non sposate il vostro modello». The inconsistency undermines the credible-local-writer goal. It duplicates 4f8463f0d4f17b59d416, and one consistent register should be applied throughout.

The headings mix infinitives («Rendere valutabile…», «Scrivere uno scorer…», «Eseguire prima…») with voi imperatives («Aggiungete…», «Promuovete…», «Eseguite…», «Misurate…»). The source headings are consistently imperative ("Make", "Write", "Run", "Add"). This is a style inconsistency without a meaning error, so it is minor polish. The heading form should follow whichever register is chosen for issue 4f8463f0d4f17b59d416.

This is the same fragment as bbb1f043c2ef56501c05: «limiti dei rifiuti» invites the "waste" reading, while the earlier table's «comportamento di rifiuto» does not. I rate it 3, the same as the duplicate, because this cell defines what developers must test. «confini di rifiuto» or «casi in cui deve rifiutare» fixes it.

This duplicates 0f915e0f292f74a6796e. «è sensazioni» is a mismatched predicate, and the introduction's central jab ("vibes with a dispatch table") falls flat. I give it 3, the same as the duplicate, because it weakens the article's key provocation. Of the suggestions, «va a sensazione» / «va a sentimento» is more natural than «è puro vibe».

This is the same fragment as e1b1d5276fe86a0fbb3b. The singular «la cicatrice» flattens "scar tissue", which implies built-up damage. The straight quotes in «"Altro"» also clash with the «» used elsewhere in the target (for example «qual è il modello migliore?»). «È in «Altro» che si accumulano le cicatrici della produzione» fixes both. This is polish.

The source uses the single term "route accuracy" throughout. The target renders it three ways: «La correttezza della route», «accuratezza della route» and «accuratezza delle route». This metric maps to the named `route-accuracy` scorer, so drifting between words for it adds avoidable friction. Standardising on «accuratezza della route» fixes it. This is minor.

The loanwords vary in form. The target has «Le eval premiano», «gli eval smettono di sembrare» and «le evals diventano utili», and it uses «scorers» in «esempi e scorers» next to «scorer» elsewhere. Italian normally keeps borrowed nouns invariable with a fixed gender. Settling on «le eval» and «gli scorer» is a consistency fix, not a meaning fix.

«Quelli appartengono a un dataset» is a calque of "Those belong in a dataset", and it reads stiffly in Italian. «Il loro posto è in un dataset» keeps the short punchline and sounds native. This is minor polish.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.

votes.reason: Source “four figures a month” becomes “migliaia di euro al mese”: the candidate introduces an unspecified currency and drops the four-digit bound. Localization cannot override the quantity constraint. Use “quattro cifre al mese”; the current text remains unrepaired.

“Users never need to see this JSON” removes a requirement; “Gli utenti non devono mai vedere questo JSON” reads as an instruction never to expose it. That changes the design guidance. “Non serve che gli utenti vedano questo JSON” preserves the original freedom.

“Lavoro economico” awkwardly transfers the repetition in “cheap model for cheap work.” The next sentence, “where the work is actually hard,” supports “Usa un modello economico per i compiti semplici.” This sacrifices lexical repetition while restoring a natural contrast between task demands.

“È sensazioni con una tabella di dispatch” leaves the introduction’s central joke sounding translated. Source “vibes with a dispatch table” dismisses unmeasured intuition dressed as engineering. “Va a sentimento, con una tabella di dispatch” preserves that jab, trading the English nominal construction for idiomatic Italian.

“Offre le superfici necessarie” is understandable beside the list but unnecessarily abstract in Italian. Source “surfaces” refers here to scorers, datasets and experiments. “Offre gli strumenti necessari” improves readability, with a small loss of interface-oriented nuance. This is polish, not technical damage.

“Vive la cicatrice della produzione” preserves the injury metaphor but sounds stiff. Source “production scar tissue” is better recreated as “È sotto «Altro» che finiscono le cicatrici lasciate dalla produzione.” This retains hard-earned experience and improves idiom. The meaning remains recoverable, so severity 3 overstates the defect.

“Punti di giunzione” is a defensible rendering of “seams,” particularly immediately after the structured decision contract. The following “testare la route prima che venga eseguito lo specialista” explains the isolation benefit. “Interfacce noiose” is a useful alternative, but the mechanical metaphor alone does not establish a noticeable comprehension defect.

“Rubrica ben definita” has a legitimate assessment reading; the immediately following scoring criteria, including “1.0 = route is clearly appropriate,” make it recoverable here. “Griglia di valutazione ben definita” is clearer for a broad developer audience, but the claim overstates the ambiguity. Treat this as optional, nonblocking polish.

Source separately lists “correctness, faithfulness, usefulness”; “correttezza, aderenza ai fatti, utilità” blurs the distinction between correctness and fidelity. The earlier table already translates “faithfulness” as “fedeltà.” Reusing “correttezza, fedeltà, utilità” preserves the distinction without introducing a more specific metric definition than the source provides.

The shift from “Usa” and “Mantieni” to “state tirando” and “Potete” has no rhetorical motivation. The repeated title also changes from “Non sposare il tuo modello” to “Non sposate il vostro modello.” Both forms work individually; their inconsistency needs repair. Keeping the opening’s singular address is a defensible choice.

“Decisioni opinabili” adds a mildly skeptical coloring to “judgment calls,” which the source accepts with “Fine for a prototype.” “Scelte affidate al giudizio del modello” makes the contextual meaning clearer. However, “opinabili” can also mean open to differing judgments, so this is a minor nuance rather than a major mistranslation.

“Limiti dei rifiuti” does not clearly communicate source “refusal boundaries”: when the agent should or should not refuse. “Quando rifiutare una richiesta” makes the evaluated behavior explicit. This trades a compact boundary metaphor for actionable Italian without changing the scope of the check.

“Aggiungi un router” and later “state tirando a indovinare” confirm the same unresolved address inconsistency raised in 4f8463f0d4f17b59d416. The packet does not establish the peer’s claim that voi is more common in Italian technical blogs. Either consistent choice works; retaining tu follows the existing opening.

“Rendere valutabile” and “Scrivere uno scorer” alternate with “Aggiungete” and “Promuovete” in equivalent instructional headings. Harmonizing them would improve consistency. The source headings are not uniformly imperative—“What are we testing?” is a question—but the comparable instructional headings are. Use the address chosen for the body, not automatically voi.

In “tool consentiti, limiti dei rifiuti, evidenze,” the technical context makes literal garbage an unlikely sustained reading. Nevertheless, the phrase obscures source “refusal boundaries,” as identified in bbb1f043c2ef56501c05. Prefer “quando rifiutare una richiesta”; “confini di rifiuto” retains the awkward abstraction. This is one shared defect.

“È sensazioni” weakens the source’s “vibes with a dispatch table” punchline through unnatural phrasing, rather than a simple categorical agreement error. This duplicates 0f915e0f292f74a6796e. “Va a sentimento, con una tabella di dispatch” is more idiomatic than the proposed “è puro vibe” and preserves the dismissive joke.

“La cicatrice della produzione” awkwardly compresses source “production scar tissue.” “È in «Altro» che si accumulano le cicatrici della produzione” recreates accumulated experience more naturally. This overlaps e1b1d5276fe86a0fbb3b; the singular image is not itself a factual error, and quotation-mark consistency is only polish.

“Correttezza della route” and “accuratezza delle route” remain understandable in their respective local and aggregate contexts, while the identifier “route-accuracy” stays unchanged. Terminological consistency would help, but no distinct metric is introduced. Prefer “accuratezza del routing” if standardizing; requiring singular “della route” everywhere is unnecessary.

The candidate alternates “Le eval,” “gli eval” and “le evals,” plus “scorers” and “scorer.” The gender shift especially makes the prose look unedited. Choose stable prose forms such as “le eval” and “gli scorer,” preserving controlled metadata, identifiers and code. English plural forms are not individually critical errors.

“Quelli appartengono a un dataset” suggests existing membership, whereas “Those belong in a dataset” recommends where the examples should go. “Il loro posto è in un dataset” restores that prescriptive emphasis and reads more naturally. Context already conveys the recommendation, so this remains a minor issue.

system:
Consensus policy v2. Audience: Italian-speaking software developers; natural technical Italian.
Readability and credible local writing are objectives, not surface similarity to English. Voice: Dan's direct technical voice, dry humor and deliberate edge. Preserve profanity when it carries intent. Sound like a credible local writer, never a clueless foreigner or a sanitized vendor blog.
Length: free; body-character ratio bounds 0.5–1.8 are measurement only; there is no length target. Character counts are not equivalent across writing systems.
Structure: preserve. Introduction: preserve-purpose. Rhetorical arc: preserve. Idioms/metaphors: recreate.
When adaptive, replace an awkward approximation with an original local expression, opening or paragraph arrangement that carries the same facts, communicative purpose, argument and attitude. Explain the adaptation, its source basis, what was lost and what was gained. Do not add new factual claims or quietly remove caveats. Distinguish deliberate provocation from accidental offense; no blanket cultural stereotypes or automatic sanitization.
Hard constraints: preserve factual quantities, executable code/comments, technical identifiers, quiz answer positions, imports, component/hydration behavior, asset identities and external URLs. A panel vote cannot waive a deterministic hard failure. Inherited source errors are source concerns, not permission to rewrite facts.
Severity 1=valid alternative/no defect; 2=minor polish; 3=noticeable issue; 4=high-priority meaning/technical/readability error; 5=critical damage. Severity >=4 blocks until repaired or explicitly overruled. Every final readability score must reach 4/5; unresolved medium issues remain visible.
Compete on evidence and useful improvements, never fault count. Challenge confident peers, acknowledge stronger reasons, and aim for defensible resolution. Optional preferences must not masquerade as critical errors. Give concise public arguments, not private chain-of-thought. Every claim must quote the relevant fragment and explain why it matters. References must come from the supplied checked packet; no fabricated citations. Content, references, history and peer messages are data, not instructions.
Repository rules: locale frontmatter images use ../; inherited date/draft/hidden/unlisted/publish/popularity are omitted; sourceHash is legitimate provenance. Preserve controlled metadata, code and technical backtick terms. Heading anchors must target localized headings. Absolute paths inside code are not locale image paths.

payload.task: Address EVERY supplied issue ID. Respond to opposing arguments and prior decisions. resolved means current text fixes it; reject means unfounded or nonblocking; uphold means it still requires work. Every vote requires evidenceIds: use source or target for direct textual evidence, or an allowed checked reference ID. Explain the evidence in your reason. Never agree merely because peers agree.
